metadata.title: Cartesian 2-D periodic N=16x16 (dx=dy=0.0625) — mixed_deriv_2nd_uniform only
metadata.description: Uniform 2-D periodic domain [0,1]x[0,1], N=16x16 cells, dx=dy=0.0625. Only the 2nd-order mixed second-derivative rule is bound so there is no rule-conflict with centered_2nd_uniform on the inner 'grad'.
